description: Playtable Club adds a new game every Monday. This sets up this week's (or an earlier one by key) for a player with a Club code, saved under the code. Without key it lists this week's game. Seats can be changed the same way as create_game, for example two human seats to play a friend.

key.description: An earlier week's game key. Leave it out for this week's.

pro_code.description: The player's Playtable Club code. Ask the player for it; never guess one.

name: weekly_game
title: Play this week's Club game
